name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Codes.card_fresh_le_finrank
title: Fresh indices are few: at most dim V indices r have v_r outside the span of the later vectors
statement: Let V be a finite-dimensional vector space over a field K and v_0, ..., v_{M-1} vectors in V. The number of indices r such that v_r is not in the span of {v_t : t > r} is at most dim V. Consequently, for a uniformly random r, v_r is a linear combination of the later vectors with probability at least 1 - dim V / M. This is the field (Hamming-metric) form of the counting step of the affine short-syzygy barrier for data-only witness-indexed WE hybrids (note pq-we-non-lattice-algebras).
